title: mini tea set with bamboo tray
text: mini tea set with bamboo tray. This is a mini set... so don't expect a full size one.  But that is exactly what I wanted.  I plan to use it for hot chocolate with my grandsons 5 and 8.  So the sizing is perfect for me.  I also plan to use it for small tea parties.  It is a bone white. One of the cups has a slight flaw on the lip of the cup - I'm holding it in the pic... but it's smooth and doesn't bother me.  Comes just as pictured, 4 cups, one teapot, one lid and one bamboo tray.  The box calls it a coffee set... perhaps espresso would work.  I washed it, top rack, in my dishwasher, no problems.  To be honest, it's perfect for me.  And it may be small in size, but as the pictures I have included show, the set is actually a decent size - although smaller than some.  The handles on the cups are nice when what you are drinking is hot.  I plan to use it happily for years, however, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
